scientific_integrity: All cardinalities and shortest-path distributions are reconstructed by two executable standalone verifiers. Same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A finite, exhaustive computer-assisted theorem for the labeled 27-vertex H(3,3), not a statement about all Hamming graphs. Priority is assessed against accessible published and indexed work; unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
title: Power-domination triples and sharp relocation detours in the ternary Hamming three-cube
